scenes.vo: Who's responsible when a drawing gets changed?
In 1981, a steel fabricator proposed splitting one rod into two on the Hyatt Regency's walkways. The shop drawings went to the engineers, and came back stamped.
But the connection was never checked against the doubled load.
After the collapse, Missouri found the engineer of record and the project engineer grossly negligent. Both lost their licences.
The profession's lesson was blunt. If your stamp is on it, it's yours.
The full case is on our channel.
